english.title: Intentionally delay / obstruct inspector's entry to premises authorised by warrant under Child Support Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), intentionally delayed or obstructed the entry of an inspector, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to premises that were occupied, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..) ,when at the time of the delay or obstruction, a warrant issued under section 15A of the Child Support Act 1991 authorised entry to those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(9)(a) and (9A) of the Child Support Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) The wording of section 15(9) was amended and a new subsection (9A) inserted, on 4th July 2019. From that date, the offence under section 15(9)(a) only applies if, at the time of the delay or obstruction, entry to the premises is authorised by a warrant issued under section 15A. For offences committed before 4th July 2019, see offence document H9296.
(ii) See section 15(2) of the Act for the function of inspectors.
(iii) See section 15(3) of the Act for the provision of certificates to every inspector.
(iv) See section 15(4) of the Act for the inspectors' powers.
(v) See section 15(4A) of the Act for the premises liable to inspection.
(vi) See section 15(8) of the Act provides for the production of certificates by inspectors.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant intentionally delayed or obstructed the entry of an inspector, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to premises that were occupied, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..) ,when at the time of the delay or obstruction, a warrant issued under section 15A of the Child Support Act 1991 authorised entry to those premises.
